shellCommands.command: npx next build 2>&1
npx next start -p 3939
npx next start -p 3939
npx next start -p 3939 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 & echo "started pid $!"
for i in $(seq 1 20); do if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3939/; then echo "ready"; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; cat /tmp/next-start.log
sleep 2; cat /tmp/next-start.log; echo "---CURL---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home_status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3939/
cat /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1; echo "==="; ps aux | grep -i "next start" | grep -v grep
cat /tmp/next-start.log; echo "===PROC==="; ps aux | grep "next start" || true
nohup npx next start -p 3939 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 & disown; echo "launched pid $!"; sleep 4; cat /tmp/next-start.log
ps aux | grep -E "next|node" | grep -v grep | head -20; echo "==="; cat /tmp/next-start.log | tail -20
npx next start -p 3939
npx next start -p 3939
npx next start -p 3939

setsid npx next start -p 3939 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo "pid $!"; sleep 5; echo "---log---"; cat /tmp/next-start.log; echo "---ps---"; ps aux | grep -E "next-server|next start" | grep -v grep || echo "no proc"

ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3939 || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3939 || echo "nothing on 3939"; echo "===try 127.0.0.1==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3939/ ; echo "exit=$?"
ps aux | grep -E "next-server|next start|npm exec" | grep -v grep || echo "no next proc"; echo "===log tail==="; tail -30 /tmp/next-start.log
npx next start -p 3939
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; echo "cleaned up"
